Indian firm eMudhra's web security keys leaked, impacting govt. sites

Web security keys belonging to Indian firm eMudhra, which provides services to government entities and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), were leaked. Major tech companies Apple and Google have blocked security certificates issued by eMudhra following the leak. While many government websites, including those of the Aadhaar issuer UIDAI and the income tax filing portal, utilize eMudhra's technology, there is no indication that the firm's root certificates, which are at a higher security tier, have been compromised.
